_comment: Copy to ~/.hermes/dreaming.json and edit. Missing keys fall back to defaults; precedence: CLI flag > DREAM_* env > this file > default.
_comment_cron: Expected cron roles for install/check. Excluded roles are not created; this never pauses existing jobs. [] deliberately expects no jobs.
_comment_excluded_threads: Threads of a TRUSTED forum chat that are not human talk: the agent's own alerts, an assistant bridge, machine-generated cards. Absent or empty = the whole chat corroborates, as before.
_comment_untrusted_sources: Session sources whose role=user rows are machine prompts. cron, subagent and tool are always excluded; add cli if a script (backup, sync, report) drives the agent non-interactively.

alias_rules.name: shopping list thread may move between ids

_comment_probes: Phrases that must stay in MEMORY.md / USER.md; one alert when one disappears.
_comment_duplicates: holographic >= 0.19.0: pairs of facts that look like one fact, asked as 'merge?' with both texts and a number (D-17); the agent merges only on a yes to that number. min_containment: the share of the shorter side's significant words the other holds; per_night: questions a night; question_cooldown_days: rest of an asked pair; max_pair_checks: the night's budget (past it: skipped, one alert); max_chars: longer facts take no part. See references/scoring.md, Duplicates across the store.
_comment_chat_stores: Only with holographic scope user / chat / thread (one database per user / chat / topic). read: list every database in the report — counts only. promote_from: chats whose facts join the pass, each corroborated by its own chat only — "telegram:-1001234567890", "telegram:-1001234567890:42" (a topic, scope thread), "telegram:123456789" (a user, scope user). Memory files are shared by all chats: a promoted chat's facts reach every chat once written there.
_comment_judge: Optional cloud judge, off by default: a decision model may take a counted mention out of the count (shadow: only report what would change; veto: apply it). Only what is listed here leaves: send_from (the word trusted, or a list of chat ids), send_sources (e.g. telegram), send_fact_stores, send_no_chat_sessions - the fact text and the person's own words, to OpenRouter (jev) and, listed second, OpenAI (openai) as the fallback. Keys: OPENROUTER_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY in the environment or in ~/.hermes/.env. See the README, Optional cloud judge.
